study type: Predictive model development and validation study
cohort: The study included 1191 parturients who delivered at Deyang People's Hospital in western China from January 2022 to December 2022 for model development, with external verification performed on data collected from January to March 2023.
finding: The Support Vector Machine (SVM) model demonstrated the best prediction ability among six machine learning models, achieving an accuracy of 0.793, a recall rate of 0.981, and an AUC of 0.882 for predicting mediolateral episiotomy risk.
